jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Node.js
jobs_results.description:
Check-in Scan, líder en soluciones tecnológicas para la gestión eficiente de check-ins y registros, está en búsqueda de un(a):

Desarrollador/a Node.js altamente motivado(a) y apasionado(a) por la innovación para unirse a nuestro equipo en La Cala de Mijas.

Responsabilidades:

Desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones backend en Node.js.

Colaborar con el equipo de frontend y diseño para crear soluciones integradas y eficientes.

Contribuir en todas las fases del desarrollo, desde la concepción hasta el lanzamiento y el soporte post-lanzamiento.

Asegurar la calidad del código, incluyendo pruebas unitarias y de integración.

Participar activamente en el proceso de revisión de código y en la mejora continua de nuestros procesos de desarrollo.

Requisitos:

Experiencia demostrable en desarrollo de aplicaciones con Node.js.

Buen conocimiento de bases de datos (SQL y NoSQL).

Familiaridad con el control de versiones, preferiblemente Git.

Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente... y en equipo.

Nos encantaría si también tienes:

Experiencia con frameworks frontend (React, Vue.js, Angular).

Conocimientos en contenedores y orquestación (Docker, Kubernetes).

Experiencia en metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).

Ofrecemos:
• Jornada completa
• Puesto presencial en La Cala de Mijas (Málaga) de lunes a jueves
• Viernes teletrabajo
• Horario: 8:00 a 15:30h

jobs_results.title: Node.JS Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are currently seeking a talented and experienced Node.js Developer

Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain server-side web applications using Node.js
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement robust APIs and backend systems
• Write clean and efficient code, following best practices and coding standards
• Conduct thorough testing and debugging of applications to ensure high-quality deliverables
• Optimize application performance and scalability
• Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in Node.js development

Requirements
• Proven experience as a Node.js Developer, with a solid understanding of Node.js and its core principles
• Proficiency in JavaScript
• Knowledge of Express.js or similar web application frameworks
• Experience with NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB
• Understanding of asynchronous programming and event-driven architectures
• Experience with version control systems, preferably Git
• Strong problem-solving skills and the... ability to work in a collaborative team environment
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Nice to have: Familiarity with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js)

We Offer
• Flexible work-hours
• part-time/full-time
• Competitive salary

jobs_results.title: Node.js Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Orange Quarter is working with a market leader in the Digital Agency space that is currently looking for a NodeJS backend developer.

This company essentially helps other businesses (big and small) providing technical solutions to suit their needs.

They have been around for 15 years and are now looking to expand their market into Spain. With an impressive office in Poble Nou, they have a team of 9 and continue to look to build their presence in the Spanish market.

Industry

OQ-industries Agency

Creative agency

OQ-industries Internet

What To Expect

As a Node.js Developer, you will support one of their biggest clients – a global player in the insurance sector – in the digital transformation of its customer management, by building and optimising digital processes and thus helping to save time, costs and paper. You will join another typescript developer and will work closely together.

This project is Germany based, and you will join one of the teams in Munich teams. However, the... Barcelona office is based in Poble Nou and you will be able to either choose to work fully remotely or go to the office on a hybrid model.

Perks
• 40 days work from anywhere / 130 days work form anywhere (depending on work package that you chose, remote or hybrid)
• Flat hierarchies, short decision-making processes and mutual trust
• Work Bike

Requirements

Requirements:
• As a TypeScript / Node.js developer, you have extensive experience in the development and maintenance of web applications.
• You dominate the following tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, Angular and have experience with Docker and CI/CD.
• Experience with Go based microservices or PHP is a plus.

Sounds good? Apply now

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de Node JS
jobs_results.description:
"Great things in business are never done by one person. They're done by a team of people." (Steve Jobs).

It is an incredible time to join our team and become one of the first ‘xplorers’ that help us grow and expand Xplore Group in Spain. Xplore Group is the most successful independent JAVA and PHP solution provider in the Benelux, present in Belgium, the Netherlands, and Spain. We have offices in cities such as Hasselt, Antwerp, Eindhoven, Amsterdam and Valencia.

Our team of highly skilled ‘xplorers’ has a unique approach, combining the experience of world-leading platforms with best practices and the latest technologies, delivering the best experience to our customers.

Xplore Group consists of 45 competence centres, each with their own unique focus on one of the lead technologies, like AWS, Salesforce, Hybris, RPA, Kubernetes, .Net, Azure DevOps. We have gone from 400 to 1200 employees in the last three years.

We have a clear view of the direction we want to take. We work in... multidisciplinary teams, where good practices and high standards are of the highest importance. We use testing, continuous integration and delivery to reduce the time to market for our clients.

Do you want to work in an international company with a startup mentality, where you can speak openly, contribute with creative ideas, learn from experienced colleagues, help us grow and become a key member of the company?

What you will be doing

You will work in one of our international projects and be part of one of our squads with team members from Spain, Belgium, and the Netherlands. You will communicate in English and memes, and use agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban.

You will put together good practices and collaborate with team members and the client to define, design and develop new functionalities.

You will apply SOLID principles and create unit tests for your functionality, validating it with the CI in Azure DevOpsand measuring it with Sonar.

The first week

You will receive and set up your MacBook PRO and equipment that will allow you to work very efficiently. Alfredo Gil, our Managing Partner and CTO, will introduce you to your colleagues. You will start your training and enjoy your first free weekly meal.

In 30 days

You will be an active member of the squad. With your professional way of working and our help, you will be of great added value to your team By making group decisions you will help shape our awesome culture and take it to the next level. You will experience for yourself how fun and rewarding it can be to work in an international environment.

You will discover the challenges of your new project. Don’t worry if you don't have all the technical skills yet, with the help of your teammates, you'll already be running at full capacity. You will experience that your English improves quickly by drinking Belgium beer at your first after-work event. Your team is eager to meet you!

In three months

You will have responsibility and ownership of one of the important parts of the e-commerce project. The client will mention the good job that you are doing.

In six months

You will be at maximum performance! Every day thousands of clients make use of your developments and have a happy shopping experience in our clients' webshops.

The international tech team of our client will congratulate you for all the value that you provide. You will pass your trial period with flying colours and you’ll have the opportunity to choose your hardware that will make you type faster than Flash. And now, it is time to celebrate!

Where you will be doing it:

Our offices are in Edificio Europa, Avenida de Aragon in the heart of Valencia’s city centre. On our 13th floor with our stunning views of all the city of Valencia, we can even see the sea from a window on the same floor. In the area, there are plenty of restaurants, cafes, shops, gyms and green areas (Valencia is very cycle-friendly). You can use super-efficient public transport; the metro is right across the street from our building.

What you bring:
• Good level of English B2/C1.
• Proven experience as a Node.js Developer, with a solid understanding of Node.js and its core principles
• Proficiency in JavaScript
• Knowledge of Express.js or similar web application frameworks
• Experience with NoSQL databases, such as MongoDBand ElasticSearch
• Experience with messaging systems like RabbitMQ and Kafka
• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes
• Experience with version control systems, preferably Github Enterprise and Github Actions
• Familiarity with front-end technologies JavaScript frameworks : React
• Experience with Atlassian stack (JIRA, Confluence, etc.)
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a collaborative team environment
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

What we bring:

• Hybrid Work. (2 days a week in the office).

• Competitive salary

• Benefits program with restaurant tickets, transport tickets, kindergarten

• Top private medical insurance paid by Xplore Group

• Warm lunch every day, coffee, tea and fresh fruits in the office

• Short working Fridays

• Grow and keep track of technologies, get certified in Java, Spring, AWS

• Work in an international environment, speaking English part of the day, occasionally traveling to Belgium and the Netherlands

jobs_results.title: Node.JS Developer with GraphQL
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for Node.JS Developer

Responsibilities
• Developing and maintaining Node.js applications in a production environment
• Creating, implementing, and documenting GraphQL API and managing data in this context
• Deploying and managing GCP services such as App Engine, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, etc.
• Optimizing and monitoring applications to ensure their performance and reliability
• Collaborating with the programming team, architects, and other stakeholders to understand business and technical requirements

Requirements
• At least 2 years of experience in Node.js programming and developing back-end applications
• Knowledge of GraphQL and experience in creating and managing GraphQL API
• Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as App Engine, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, etc.
• Ability to work with databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
• Knowledge of version control tools such as Git
• Problem-solving skills, code analysis, and... performance optimization
• Good command of spoken and written English

We Offer
• B2B contract type
• Full-time employment
• Remote and flexible working hours

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Node.js con Francés
jobs_results.description:
¿Buscas un lugar de trabajo que te permita asumir nuevos retos diariamente y formarte de manera continua en un ambiente dinámico y global con infinidad de oportunidades? ¡En el European Industrial Center de Capgemini esto es posible!

En el AD Center de Valencia queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo un desarrollador con experiencia en Node.js y/o Angular.

¿Qué buscamos?:
– Experiencia como Full Stack o especialista en Front o Back con al menos 2 años de experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones web en Node.js
– Experiencia de al menos 2 años en Frontend y movilidad, teniendo conocimientos de Javascript y/o Typescript y Angular y/o React.
– Conocimientos de ingeniería del software, por ejemplo, en patrones de arquitectura.
– Análisis y programación de alto nivel en Node.js y/o Java y/o Angular/React.
– Experiencia en programación de BBDD
– Francés, mínimo B2.

Valoraremos positivamente:
– Conocimientos de desarrollo de aplicaciones en Java o .Net
– Capacidad de Testing
– Certificación... en Java7 o Java8
– Certificación Scrum, AWS, o Azure

¿Qué nos hace diferentes?
Las ganas de apostar por gente con pasión por este sector. Buscamos personas que quieran aprender y crecer profesionalmente dentro de un área en constante cambio, ofreciéndoles la oportunidad de trabajar desde el inicio en grandes proyectos para consolidados clientes a nivel global; con las tecnologías más innovadoras del mercado, y con un nivel de responsabilidad 100% acorde a su potencial y proyección. ¡Invertimos en tu futuro y formación para llevarte a lo más alto!

¿Qué ofrecemos?
– Contratación estable desde el primer día.
– Formación inicial e incorporación en equipos de trabajo dentro proyectos innovadores y de transformación (tanto a nivel nacional como internacional)
– Un plan de desarrollo profesional acorde a tus capacidades e intereses, con posibilidades de formarte en nuevas áreas o tecnologías que sean de tu interés
– Un excepcional ambiente de trabajo, colaborativo y motivador, con actividades de team building, competiciones y concursos internos, torneos de video juegos, y mucho más
– Un plan de ventajas sociales (tickets restaurantes, cheques guardería y seguro médico y de vida)
– Una jornada laboral flexible y conciliadora con la vida familiar, con posibilidad de teletrabajo varios días por semana
– Oportunidades de viajar y de movilidad geográfica (nacional e internacional)
– Formar parte de una empresa responsable y comprometida con la igualdad de oportunidades.

Durante la situación actual de COVID19:
– Promovemos la seguridad y salud de todos y todas, incentivando el trabajo 100% remoto hasta que la situación permita garantizar un entorno de trabajo seguro
– Nuestros canales de comunicación nos permiten un trabajo en equipo real y eficiente, estando conectados entre sí en gran parte de nuestras tareas. Aun desde casa, seguimos incorporando, reuniéndonos, impartiendo formación y creando actividades de equipo.

Capgemini

items:
¿Buscas un lugar de trabajo que te permita asumir nuevos retos diariamente y formarte de manera continua en un ambiente dinámico y global con infinidad de oportunidades? ¡En el European Industrial Center de Capgemini esto es posible!

En el AD Center de Valencia queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo un desarrollador con experiencia en Node.js y/o Angular.

¿Qué buscamos?:
– Experiencia como Full Stack o especialista en Front o Back con al menos 2 años de experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones web en Node.js
– Experiencia de al menos 2 años en Frontend y movilidad, teniendo conocimientos de Javascript y/o Typescript y Angular y/o React.
– Conocimientos de ingeniería del software, por ejemplo, en patrones de arquitectura.
– Análisis y programación de alto nivel en Node.js y/o Java y/o Angular/React.
– Experiencia en programación de BBDD
– Francés, mínimo B2.

Valoraremos positivamente:
– Conocimientos de desarrollo de aplicaciones en Java o .Net
– Capacidad de Testing
– Certificación... en Java7 o Java8
– Certificación Scrum, AWS, o Azure

¿Qué nos hace diferentes?
Las ganas de apostar por gente con pasión por este sector. Buscamos personas que quieran aprender y crecer profesionalmente dentro de un área en constante cambio, ofreciéndoles la oportunidad de trabajar desde el inicio en grandes proyectos para consolidados clientes a nivel global; con las tecnologías más innovadoras del mercado, y con un nivel de responsabilidad 100% acorde a su potencial y proyección. ¡Invertimos en tu futuro y formación para llevarte a lo más alto!

¿Qué ofrecemos?
– Contratación estable desde el primer día.
– Formación inicial e incorporación en equipos de trabajo dentro proyectos innovadores y de transformación (tanto a nivel nacional como internacional)
– Un plan de desarrollo profesional acorde a tus capacidades e intereses, con posibilidades de formarte en nuevas áreas o tecnologías que sean de tu interés
– Un excepcional ambiente de trabajo, colaborativo y motivador, con actividades de team building, competiciones y concursos internos, torneos de video juegos, y mucho más
– Un plan de ventajas sociales (tickets restaurantes, cheques guardería y seguro médico y de vida)
– Una jornada laboral flexible y conciliadora con la vida familiar, con posibilidad de teletrabajo varios días por semana
– Oportunidades de viajar y de movilidad geográfica (nacional e internacional)
– Formar parte de una empresa responsable y comprometida con la igualdad de oportunidades.

Durante la situación actual de COVID19:
– Promovemos la seguridad y salud de todos y todas, incentivando el trabajo 100% remoto hasta que la situación permita garantizar un entorno de trabajo seguro
– Nuestros canales de comunicación nos permiten un trabajo en equipo real y eficiente, estando conectados entre sí en gran parte de nuestras tareas. Aun desde casa, seguimos incorporando, reuniéndonos, impartiendo formación y creando actividades de equipo.

Capgemini

jobs_results.title: Node.js developer
jobs_results.description:
Our client, a leading multinational company in the leisure and entertainment sector, currently in the process of expansion, with several work centers throughout Spain, and more than 500 employees.

Within its expansion plan we are looking for a Node.js Developer, He/She will be part of a team of developers working on the digital international group platform.

Main Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

Rebuilding of the group’s websites.
Creation of new sites and/or sites for new jurisdictions (countries).
Development of interfaces for new gaming providers.
Updating existing interfaces or protocols.
Development and maintenance of backend processes.
Development and maintenance of new frontend functionalities.
Knowledge, Expertise and Qualifications:

+3 years of experience using NodeJS.
Desirable/valuable: knowledge and experience with Express JS and Hexagonal Architecture.
Javascript, JQuery
HTML5/CSS3.
Desirable knowledge of PHP with any MVC framework (i.e.: Laravel, Symfony... Codelgniter, etc.). as our current platform is built in PHP.
SQL
GIT
A technical level in English is a must.

Knowledge of:

Azure cloud (desirable)
Design for mobile/responsive
Basic Linux knowledge.
Personal Qualities:

Ability to prioritize a wide range of workloads.
Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Patient and professional demeanour, with a can-do attitude.
We offer:

Full-time from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. with flexible hours and telework of 100% after the onboarding period, and 2 or 3 days a month arranged in the offices.
Work center: Barcelona (center), living in Barcelona area or willing to relocate.
intensive summer hours
Salary: Competitive depending on experience and ability of the candidate
